name: Pharmacy
description: Retail pharmacy: prescription-gated dispensing, controlled-substance tracking, OTC and general retail counter.

roles.name: Pharmacy Manager
roles.description: Owns pharmacy operations and controlled-substance oversight.

roles.name: Pharmacist
roles.description: Verifies prescriptions and approves controlled-substance dispensing.

roles.name: Pharmacy Technician
roles.description: Runs the counter till and prescription intake.

ai_knowledge.domain_notes: A sale line for a `requires_prescription=True` product is hard-gated at checkout on a valid, non-exhausted `Prescription` (same pattern as serial-number checkout validation) — no request/auth threading needed since it's pure product-state. `controlled_substance` dispensing is provisioned here as a pharmacist-role approval policy (`controlled_substance_dispense`) but is NOT yet wired into checkout enforcement — that requires threading a `request`/actor through `checkout_order`, which today takes no request argument; treat this as a real gap, not a silent omission. Prescription/schedule categorization here is jurisdiction-neutral placeholder — a real deployment must map `controlled_substance` to actual local pharmacy regulation before launch.
starter_prompts: Show controlled substance dispense log this week.
